scope: Shared public citation/display metadata only; all 200 original term records and 9 proposals remain exact. No scientific definition, naming, permission or capability change.

published-models-for-brain-scans-and-sca.qualification: BrainLM version 1 is supported here at the abstract-level model and modality description. Neuro-GPT uses author version 4 for the cited EEG mechanism; exact equivalence to the IEEE final publication remains unverified. No performance result is transferred.

ndt2_2023.supported_scope: Multi-context pretraining on intracortical spiking activity; binned neural patches and session/subject/task embeddings. Inputs include monkey/human M1 motor tasks.
ndt2_2023.limits: These are modality-specific prediction methods. No universal gain from arbitrary pooled datasets or proof of whole-body neural translation is supplied.

poyo2023.identity: Azabou et al.(2023),A Unified,Scalable Framework for Neural Population Decoding;NeurIPS36:44937–44956
poyo2023.supported_scope: Unit embeddings and event timestamps tokenize spikes; cross-attention compresses variable populations into latent tokens. New-session embeddings can be learned without asserting matched cells.
poyo2023.limits: Overall curated inventory and particular pretrained subsets have different denominators. Mechanism precedent does not prove NeuroTranslation performance, biological causality or universal transfer.

brainlm2023.identity: Ortega Caro et al.(2023),BrainLM:A foundation model for brain activity recordings;bioRxiv2023.09.12.557460v1
brainlm2023.supported_scope: The cited preprint describes fMRI-based representation learning, distinct from intracortical spikes or scalp EEG.
brainlm2023.limits: Only modality/model role is supported here; detailed version1 methods were blocked. The v2 text returned in search was not substituted for version1. Preserve preprint status.

neurogpt2024.identity: Cui et al.(2024),Neuro-GPT:Towards A Foundation Model for EEG;ISBI DOI10.1109/ISBI56570.2024.10635453
neurogpt2024.supported_scope: An EEG encoder and GPT predict masked embedded EEG chunks; downstream motor-imagery classification uses BCIIV2a nine subjects.
neurogpt2024.limits: This supports the manuscript’s mechanism/modality claim. Exact equivalence of authorv4 to IEEE final remains unverified; no performance number is imported and full GPT did not improve every condition.
neurogpt2024.access: Relevant authorv4 methods/results read;final-publication exact equivalence not checked

nlb2021.identity: Pei et al.(2021),Neural Latents Benchmark21;NeurIPS Datasets&Benchmarks1
nlb2021.supported_scope: Common neural-population modeling tasks and distinct source datasets support the bounded benchmark description.
nlb2021.limits: A project-specific split,130-unit source subset and local score are not independently authenticated by the benchmark citation alone. No official benchmark ranking follows.
nlb2021.access: Primary PDF obtained;role reviewed,not complete benchmark re-execution

reachGraspV1.identity: Reach&Grasp: a multimodal dataset of the whole upper-limb during simple and complex movements (version 1.0, 2025)
reachGraspV1.scope: Selected pair attribution only; recorded prior MD5 verification, not fresh payload or scientific validation.

doomflyMethodsPinned.scope: Source injects observer-state threat geometry; authors identify MaleCNS, a failed looming test and a separately trained readout. The pinned release explicitly excludes the named v5 checkpoint. These facts do not establish natural vision, reproduction of gameplay or biological learning.
